name: Lugaidh

attributes.attribute: a name shared by several Irish heroes

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Lugaidh, also written Lugaid or Lughaidh, is a name that several heroes in Irish legend share. The old tales give the name to a number of different men, each with his own story.

okr.objective: Document the name Lugaidh and the heroes who carried it.
key_results: Lugaidh is a name used by several heroes
It is also written Lugaid and Lughaidh
Each hero who bore it has a separate tale
The name appears across many old Irish stories
